about: Pudding's friend went mushroom picking in the west woods and got lost. Look at three clues (things with a star over them); then the lost friend turns up in the clearing and follows you back to Pudding's cottage. The people and clues themselves are in world/regions/woods.json (written by scripts/tools/map-authoring/woods_objects.py). {@forest-imp} is the lost friend's name.
title: Lost in the Forest

say: OH, {name}! I'M SO GLAD TO SEE YOU.
{@forest-imp} WENT MUSHROOM PICKING THIS MORNING AND HASN'T COME HOME!
COULD YOU LOOK FOR CLUES IN THE WOODS? THINGS WITH A LITTLE STAR OVER THEM MIGHT HELP.

steps.objective: Look for clues in the woods ({have} of {need})

forest-pudding: YOU FOUND {have} OF {need} CLUES. KEEP LOOKING, {name}!
{@forest-imp} LOVES THE STREAM AND THE BIG RED MUSHROOMS.
gardener: THE LITTLE ONE FROM THE WOODS? I SAW THEM SKIPPING PAST WITH A BASKET THIS MORNING.
mama-hen: CLUCK! I HEARD LITTLE FOOTSTEPS GOING INTO THE WOODS.

say: (SHH... LISTEN! A LITTLE SNIFFLE IS COMING FROM THE QUIET CLEARING.)

complete.speaker: forest-pudding
say: THANK YOU, {name}. YOU FOLLOWED EVERY CLUE, LIKE A REAL DETECTIVE.
PLEASE TAKE THIS SHINY EMERALD. WE FOUND IT DEEP IN THE WOODS.
OH, AND I PUSHED THAT OLD MOSSY LOG OFF THE LITTLE BRIDGE BY MUSHROOM ISLE. I WONDER WHAT'S HIDING OVER THERE...
